title: Insurance Claim Services Category Reassessment: Extraction Difference
content:
**Rule.** In an Insurance Claim Services category reassessment supplement, the extraction difference is set as follows: for a job dispatched at a Clean or Gray Water tier whose recorded category is category 3, the extraction square feet billed multiplied by the difference between the Black Water extraction rate and the dispatch tier's extraction rate; for a job dispatched at a Clean Water tier whose recorded category is category 2, the extraction square feet billed multiplied by the difference between the Gray Water extraction rate and the dispatch tier's extraction rate; otherwise no extraction difference.

The tier, the recorded water category, the affected area and the extraction lines are those of the Water Damage Mitigation job; the dispatch tier's extraction rate is the extraction rate per square foot of the Water Damage Mitigation tier the job was dispatched at.

## Rates the recorded category selects (per square foot)

| Rate | Standard Loss (affected area below 2000 sq ft) | Large Loss (2000 sq ft or more) |
|---|---|---|
| Black Water extraction | 0.94 | 0.85 |
| Gray Water extraction | 0.78 | 0.70 |

## Decision table

| Dispatched at | Recorded category | Extraction difference |
|---|---|---|
| Clean Water or Gray Water tier | category 3 | extraction square feet billed multiplied by (Black Water rate less the dispatch tier's rate) |
| Clean Water tier | category 2 | extraction square feet billed multiplied by (Gray Water rate less the dispatch tier's rate) |
| Gray Water tier | category 2 | none |
| Black Water tier, or any tier with category 1 recorded | any | none |

*Hypothetical:* 760 square feet of extraction billed on a Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss job at 0.62, affected area 1480 square feet, recorded category 3: 760 multiplied by 0.32 (0.94 less 0.62) is 243.20. Recorded category 2 instead: 760 multiplied by 0.16 (0.78 less 0.62) is 121.60.
